title: SubstitutionBenchmarkDataset
description: Curated, scientifically verified element-substitution benchmark dataset for functional materials, strictly separating primary isostructural substitution/alloying cases from secondary dilute-doping supporting evidence.

evaluation_rules.hit_at_k: Evaluated exclusively on primary_cases known_substituents. A case is hit if ANY known_substituent appears in Top-K.
evaluation_rules.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the highest-ranked valid known substituent in primary_cases.
evaluation_rules.recall_at_k: Fraction of valid known substituents recovered within Top-K for each case, averaged across primary_cases.
evaluation_rules.secondary_cases_rule: Strictly contextual / qualitative. NEVER counted as positive ground truth for quantitative evaluation metrics.

leakage_control_strategy.feature_construction: No benchmark cases or known substituent labels were used to generate elemental features in elements_master.parquet.
leakage_control_strategy.unsupervised_representations: All three similarity engines (PN, Atom2Vec, S_prop) are completely unsupervised and receive only (target_element) as input at test time.
leakage_control_strategy.blind_evaluation: Top-K candidate shortlists are generated purely from elemental similarity matrices without access to known_substituents.

resulting_compositions: (Al_x Ga_{1-x})2 O3 (monoclinic beta-phase up to x ≈ 0.70)
(In_x Ga_{1-x})2 O3 (monoclinic beta-phase up to x ≈ 0.35)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Synthesized as single crystals, bulk ceramics, and epitaxial thin films (MBE, MOCVD, PLD) preserving C2/m space group.
primary_cases.computational_status: Supported by DFT formation energy convex hulls and phonon stability calculations (Peelaers et al., 2017).
primary_cases.source_reference: Peelaers et al., Appl. Phys. Lett. 112, 242101 (2018); Baldini et al., J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 30, 194001 (2018)
primary_cases.verification_notes: Both Al and In substitute directly on the Ga_II octahedral 4i site forming verified solid solutions. Heterovalent/dilute donors (Si, Sn) are strictly excluded from primary targets and moved to secondary cases.

resulting_compositions: Al_x Ga_{1-x} N (continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
In_x Ga_{1-x} N (solid solution up to x ≈ 0.40 in commercial LEDs)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Extensively commercialized optoelectronic alloys grown via MOVPE and MBE; complete tetrahedral cation sublattice substitution.
primary_cases.computational_status: Well-documented electronic band gap bowing and formation enthalpies across the ternary phase diagram.
primary_cases.source_reference: Ambacher, J. Phys. D: Appl. Phys. 31, 2653 (1998); Nakamura et al., Nobel Lecture (2015)
primary_cases.verification_notes: Hexagonal wurtzite has exactly one Wyckoff site (2b) for the cation; substitution is geometrically unique and experimentally proven. Mg acceptor doping is moved to secondary cases.

resulting_compositions: Mo_{1-x} W_x S2 (continuous isostructural solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Synthesized as 2D monolayers and bulk layered crystals across the entire compositional join via CVD and CVT.
primary_cases.computational_status: Negative mixing enthalpy across the entire binary join; ideal solid solution (Chen et al., 2013).
primary_cases.verification_notes: Continuous isostructural replacement of Mo by W on the 2c site preserving the 2H polytype.

resulting_compositions: MoS_{2(1-x)} Se_{2x} (continuous isostructural solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Synthesized via chemical vapor deposition (CVD) as single-layer alloys and bulk crystals with continuously tunable optical band gaps.
primary_cases.computational_status: DFT-calculated formation energies confirm thermodynamic stability and miscibility (Gong et al., 2014).
primary_cases.verification_notes: Isovalent anion substitution on the 4f Wyckoff position preserving space group P6_3/mmc.

resulting_compositions: BaTi_{1-x} Zr_x O3 (BaZrO3-BaTiO3 continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
BaTi_{1-x} Sn_x O3 (BaSnO3-BaTiO3 continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
BaTi_{1-x} Hf_x O3 (BaHfO3-BaTiO3 continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Widely fabricated as lead-free piezoelectric ceramics, multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), and thin films.
primary_cases.computational_status: DFT phonon dispersion and tolerance factor modeling verify stability of B-site replacement.
primary_cases.source_reference: Ravez et al., Ferroelectrics 109, 219 (1990); Wei et al., J. Appl. Phys. 101, 054110 (2007)
primary_cases.verification_notes: Isovalent Group 4 / Group 14 metal substitution on the 1b octahedral B-site. Si is rejected due to ionic radius collapse and phase separation.

resulting_compositions: Ba_{1-x} Sr_x TiO3 (BST, continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
Ba_{1-x} Ca_x TiO3 (BCT, solid solution up to x ≈ 0.30)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Barium strontium titanate (BST) is the gold standard tunable microwave dielectric ceramic, verified by thousands of diffraction studies.
primary_cases.computational_status: Convex hull analysis in Materials Project shows complete stability of mixed A-site titanates.
primary_cases.source_reference: Landolt-Bornstein Group III Vol. 36A (Springer-Verlag, 2001); MP database
primary_cases.verification_notes: Isovalent alkaline earth substitution on the 12-coordinated A-site preserving the perovskite framework.

resulting_compositions: SrTi_{1-x} Zr_x O3 (continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
SrTi_{1-x} Hf_x O3 (continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Synthesized via solid-state reaction and pulsed laser deposition as high-k gate dielectrics.
primary_cases.computational_status: Negative enthalpy of mixing across the solid-solution series in OQMD and Materials Project.
primary_cases.source_reference: Materials Project entry mp-4648; ICSD entry 89258
primary_cases.verification_notes: Homovalent Group 4 B-site replacement. Nb donor doping is moved to secondary cases.

resulting_compositions: Sr_{1-x} Ba_x TiO3 (continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
Sr_{1-x} Ca_x TiO3 (continuous solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Well-characterized quantum paraelectric ceramic solid solutions.
primary_cases.computational_status: DFT-verified tolerance factor and phonon stability.
primary_cases.source_reference: Materials Project entry mp-4648; ICSD entry 24111
primary_cases.verification_notes: A-site isovalent substitution preserving the 1a Wyckoff site.

resulting_compositions: CsPb_{1-x} Sn_x I3 (continuous lead-free halide perovskite solid solution, 0 <= x <= 1.0)
primary_cases.experimental_status: Synthesized as single crystals, thin films, and colloidal quantum dots for photovoltaic solar cells.
primary_cases.computational_status: Bandgap bowing and thermodynamic miscibility confirmed by DFT (Stoumpos et al., 2013).
primary_cases.source_reference: Stoumpos et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 135, 9093-9109 (2013)
primary_cases.verification_notes: Ge is rejected from primary ground truth due to negligible solubility (<5%) and severe octahedral distortion. Sn forms an experimentally validated isostructural solid solution. Bi is rejected due to double perovskite phase separation.

primary_cases.experimental_status: The preeminent commercial p-type thermoelectric alloy at room temperature, produced industrially via zone melting and spark plasma sintering.
primary_cases.computational_status: Electronic structure and topological surface states thoroughly characterized across the binary join.
primary_cases.verification_notes: Bi and Sb form an uninterrupted isostructural solid solution on the 6c cation site.

primary_cases.experimental_status: The commercial standard n-type thermoelectric cooling material; Se occupies preferential 3a/6c anion sublattices.
primary_cases.computational_status: First-principles electronic structure calculations confirm site preference and band convergence.
primary_cases.source_reference: Materials Project entry mp-1204; ICSD entry 627122
primary_cases.verification_notes: Isovalent chalcogen substitution across the entire composition join preserving R-3m symmetry.

secondary_doping_cases.dopant_role: n-type shallow donor (carrier concentrations 1e16 to 1e19 cm^-3)
secondary_doping_cases.experimental_status: Verified by Hall effect, SIMS, and C-V profiling on beta-Ga2O3 single crystals.
secondary_doping_cases.source_reference: Villora et al., Appl. Phys. Express 1, 041201 (2008)
secondary_doping_cases.context_usage_note: Used ONLY for qualitative interpretation of recommendations (e.g. explaining why Si appears in Ga2O3 recommendations). STRICTLY EXCLUDED from Hit@K and MRR.

secondary_doping_cases.experimental_status: Sn-doped beta-Ga2O3 grown by floating zone and edge-defined film-fed growth (EFG).
secondary_doping_cases.source_reference: Sasaki et al., Appl. Phys. Lett. 100, 142106 (2012)
secondary_doping_cases.context_usage_note: Used ONLY for qualitative interpretation. STRICTLY EXCLUDED from Hit@K and MRR.

secondary_doping_cases.dopant_role: p-type acceptor dopant (activation via LEEBI / thermal annealing)
secondary_doping_cases.experimental_status: Enabled the commercial blue LED (Nakamura, Akasaki, Amano; Nobel Prize 2014).
secondary_doping_cases.source_reference: Nakamura et al., Jpn. J. Appl. Phys. 34, L797 (1995)
secondary_doping_cases.context_usage_note: Mg is a dilute acceptor (< 0.1 at%), not a bulk solid solution. Strictly excluded from primary evaluation.

secondary_doping_cases.dopant_role: n-type conducting donor substrate (0.1 to 0.7 wt% Nb)
secondary_doping_cases.experimental_status: Commercial conducting substrate for perovskite oxide thin-film epitaxy.
secondary_doping_cases.context_usage_note: Dilute donor doping. Strictly excluded from primary substitution metrics.

secondary_doping_cases.experimental_status: Direct atomic imaging of Re dopant atoms substituting Mo via STM and STEM.
secondary_doping_cases.context_usage_note: Sub-percent defect doping. Strictly excluded from primary substitution metrics.
